output.reason: The only evidence is a one-line release note [ev-371cba9ffb93]. It says SourceNamespaces now filters destinations (envoy clusters) for unreachable routes, but it does not say what an exposed environment experiences. It also does not say whether this is on by default or needs configuration. The proposal says this changes destination selection behaviour, but the note does not support that; it suggests only that clusters for routes that cannot be reached are left out. To decide, we need the linked PR or issue (51936) or docs that state the runtime effect, for example whether traffic, cluster counts or config size change for existing SourceNamespaces users.
